patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AI InteleKt and Turbotic share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose AI InteleKt only if your buying job matches “AI InteleKt is a customer data and retail intelligence platform — unify POS, web, and mobi” rather than Turbotic's shape. Choose Turbotic only if your buying job matches “Automation AI platform — Free tier; Basic from $14.99/mo annual; Pro from $79.99/mo annual” rather than AI InteleKt's shape. Workflow advantage: AI InteleKt leans marketing-automation; Turbotic leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — AI InteleKt and Turbotic share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

- Company-size focus: AI InteleKt (small-business, mid-market) vs Turbotic (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: AI InteleKt-leaning marketing-automation vs Turbotic-leaning —.
- Researched limits: AI InteleKt — none listed; Turbotic — Newer platform — confirm enterprise references and connector catalog depth.

Limitations — AI InteleKt: —; Turbotic: Newer platform — confirm enterprise references and connector catalog depth; Execution/chat quotas vary by tier — monitor usage on Free and Basic.
